newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kodak said raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kodak said raised to buy.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Peter Enderlin upgraded Eastman Kodak Co to buy from outperform, according to his office.
-- Enderlin said in a research note that he expects a "good pickup in revenues in March."
-- said company will soon introduce several digital imaging products "with very attractive price/performance features."
-- believes "fundamental long-term growth story -- international growth, new products, and digital imaging -- is still intact."
-- set price target of $101. Shares rose one to 76-1/4.
